programme.title: Foodwise: Wuyi Mountains
programme.desc: The hosts are in the Wuyi Mountains of Fujian Province, the birthplace of oolong tea. Here they enjoy tea ceremony on a bamboo raft, feast on everything from smoked goose to lotus seed soup, and explore an ancient town that once sold tea to Russia. They discover that here it’s all about terroir, and that nestled within the cliffs of the Wuyi Mountains is the most expensive tea in the world.

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: Pak Mei
programme.desc: In Foshan, China, Kleber seeks out Liu Weixin, a master of Pak Mei kungfu and on whom the hit game "Sifu" was based. He experiences for himself this style's relentless and lightning-fast strikes, but also learns from its master how to balance life and kungfu, how a master should treat his disciples, and what it means to "eat porridge at night"

programme.title: China Popcast: All you need to know for traveling in China this summer
programme.desc: Traveling in China for the first time can be a little easier if you know a few things beforehand. In this episode of China Popcast, we tell you which maps to use, how to pay for things, offer advice on how to book tickets for major attractions, share information on China's current travel visa policies and more. Our guests Chen Hongpeng, a Beijing-based tour guide, and CGTN China Travel host Jack Klumpp join the show to give you expert tips for your China trip this summer. And new China Popcast host Min Rui gets the show going with quickfire questions on the "dos and don'ts."

programme.title: Brian Linden: Take me home, country roads
programme.desc: "Since first arriving in China in 1984, Brian Linden has built a bond with the country that now spans more than four decades. For over 20 years, he has been rooted in Xizhou, a historic town in Yunnan. Drawn by Eastern culture, he arrived as an outsider but gradually became a dedicated rural builder.Though he has traveled to more than 120 countries, Linden ultimately chose to settle in rural southwest China. What inspired him to stay, and what China story does he hope to share with the world? Follow Linden’s journey as we explore his life in rural China."

programme.title: Ancient tradition in an old town takes on new life
programme.desc: The Chinese lion dance is an art form that combines acrobatics, dance, folk music and embroidery. The southern style lion dance was a staple in the ancient town of Qiantong before the costume faded in the early 20th century. However, now the tradition has been revived by some incredible talented young people from this town.

programme.title: Nature’s Bounty
programme.desc: In this episode, we start from hiking up volcanoes in Datong. There is a large volcanic cluster with over 30 cones. Then we come to the Hanging Temple – a 1,500-year-old monastery clutching at a cliff of Mount Hengshan. Join us for an adrenaline-pumping adventure!

programme.title: Brian Linden: Take me home, country roads
programme.desc: "Since first arriving in China in 1984, Brian Linden has built a bond with the country that now spans more than four decades. For over 20 years, he has been rooted in Xizhou, a historic town in Yunnan. Drawn by Eastern culture, he arrived as an outsider but gradually became a dedicated rural builder.Though he has traveled to more than 120 countries, Linden ultimately chose to settle in rural southwest China. What inspired him to stay, and what China story does he hope to share with the world? Follow Linden’s journey as we explore his life in rural China."

programme.title: Valentine's with the Snake King
programme.desc: Every year on Qixi Festival (Chinese Valentine's Day), the town of Zhanghu in Nanping, Fujian Province hosts a folk custom event: the Snake King Parade. Local residents carry the statue of the Snake King from the temple, along with specially prepared pythons, and parade through the streets and alleys. Wherever the procession passes, residents and shopkeepers greet them with firecrackers and burn incense to pray, hoping to receive the unique blessing of the Snake King. This distinctive folk activity is rarely seen elsewhere across China. Taking this event as its highlight, the episode leads audiences on a deep dive into the towns and villages of northern Fujian, delivering a highly...

programme.title: A Magic Chinese New Year
programme.desc: During the Year‑of‑the‑Ox Spring Festival, we visited Gubei Water Town in Miyun District, Beijing. Join host He Tianran to experience an authentic northern‑style Spring Festival. We will paste paper lanterns, cut paper‑cut window decorations, watch sugar‑blowing craftsmanship and release sky lanterns. Let us embrace this blessed Year of the Ox together.

programme.title: Ancient tradition in an old town takes on new life
programme.desc: The Chinese lion dance is an art form that combines acrobatics, dance, folk music and embroidery. The southern style lion dance was a staple in the ancient town of Qiantong before the costume faded in the early 20th century. However, now the tradition has been revived by some incredible talented young people from this town.

programme.title: Foodwise: Hangzhou Ep.1
programme.desc: In this episode Tianran and Hannah are in Hangzhou, a city with over 2000 years of history and capital of two ancient Chinese dynasties. From the famous West Lake to delicate Dragon Well tea, our hosts experience Hangzhou's must-do attractions, savouring the local cuisine and trying everything from winter melon shaped like pork belly, to food cooked according to Traditional Chinese Medicine principles, and even Buddhist noodles and Zen tea.

programme.title: Foodwise: Hangzhou Ep.1

programme.title: Foodwise: Hangzhou Ep.2
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran and Hannah continue their tea-tasting journey along Hangzhou's Qiantang River, exploring the region's historical culture and culinary delights. They head to Anding Mountain, enjoying misty tea at the summit. In Longmen Ancient Town, they dive into traditional Chinese clan culture and savor “Sun Quan seitan”. In the gentrified village of Shishe, Hannah falls in love with “gray soup rice dumplings”, while at Qiandao Lake Tianran tries the best fish head and beluga caviar he’s ever had in his life. Their journey ends with a cup of Jiukeng tea and a visit to ancient tea trees.

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: Hung Ga and Choy Li Fut
programme.desc: In Foshan, China, Kleber meets with two masters of southern Chinese martial arts. He learns from a Hung Ga master that while this kungfu style is often associated with brute force, it’s actually a combination of hard and soft techniques that can also be used in traditional Chinese massage. Next, Kleber meets a master of Choy Li Fut, a kungfu style that utilizes everyday items such as towels, fans and even abacuses, and discovers the link between martial arts and lion dance.

programme.title: China Bound：Xiamen
programme.desc: What's it like in one of China's happiest cities? Tianran is in sunny Xiamen on China's southeast coast, visiting the city's famous "island of music" and sampling local delicacies like shark meatballs, shacha noodles and fish in "soy sauce water". He'll discover former fishing villages turned hipster havens, drink tea with locals beneath traditional tenement buildings, and visit a student enclave brimming with creative startup energy.

programme.title: China Highly Recommended: Changsha
programme.desc: Episode 1 of Travelogue's "China Highly Recommended" tells the story of Changsha, one of China's happiest cities. Following the lives of four of its foreign residents: A French executive chef, a Japanese podcaster, and two American teachers, we discover the reasons why they made Changsha their second home, and explore the city with them as only locals do. This episode will be released as a 30 minute travel documentary to be broadcast on CGTN's television channel and social media platform, along with a series of video clips and photos

programme.title: Young star on green field
programme.desc: Meet Sun Chenxi, a 12-year-old soccer "star" from Ningbo who first picked up the game at the age of four and is already playing with the confidence of a veteran. Sun says he dreams of turning pro one day and leading China's men's team to the World Cup. Dribbling and passing with skills far more advanced than his age, he has won over audiences far and wide after his father posted clips of Sun flashing his fancy footwork on social media. The soon-to-be-teenager now has millions of followers online. Already recognized as a rising young talent, high hopes are pinned on Sun as he is cheered on by his parents, friends, and throngs of fans online.

programme.title: Life as a Miao Embroidery Girl
programme.desc: In this episode, host Eva May travels to Maomaohe Village in Leishan County, Guizhou Province — a place renowned for its exquisite Miao embroidery. She spends a week immersing herself in the daily lives of local embroidery artisans, learning traditional Miao folk songs, and rising to the challenge of creating a piece of Miaoxiu embroidery with special cultural significance.

programme.title: Navigating the Hills of Chongqing
programme.desc: This episode explores the transportation ingenuity of Chongqing, the Fog City. Surrounded by mountains and rivers, this megacity solves topographic challenges with the Yangtze River Cableway, Asia's second-longest escalator, and a train passing through a building. From the dock culture at the confluence of two rivers to a logistics hub linking China and Europe, witness its transformation from an inland town to an economic center via the Go West policy.

programme.title: Bird-eye China Ep.1
programme.desc: Unfolding between the Kunlun, Altai and Tianshan ranges, cradling two vast basins, lies a beautiful land: Xinjiang. Join us on an aerial journey as we ascend the Tianshan to reveal the life-giving secrets of its crystal clear waters, before touching the summit of Bogda Peak, towering 5 km above sea-level, and gliding over the glittering, gem-like Tianchi Lake and the boundless grasslands that extend far beyond what even a bird’s eye can see into the west….

programme.title: Navigating the Hills of Chongqing
programme.desc: This episode explores the transportation ingenuity of Chongqing, the Fog City. Surrounded by mountains and rivers, this megacity solves topographic challenges with the Yangtze River Cableway, Asia's second-longest escalator, and a train passing through a building. From the dock culture at the confluence of two rivers to a logistics hub linking China and Europe, witness its transformation from an inland town to an economic center via the Go West policy.

programme.title: Bird-eye China Ep.1

programme.title: Foodwise: Shantou
programme.desc: Tianran and Hannah are in Shantou, Guangdong Province in south China, where they drink more tea than anywhere else in the country. They'll savor the complex aroma of the curiously named "Duck Poo Fragrance" tea, as well as enjoy a more traditional "yum cha" breakfast. They get a taste of traditional handicrafts, from breaking bowls to make inlaid porcelain to rolling "kueh" rice cakes, and feast on everything from sweet and savory street snacks to the finest seafood dining.

programme.title: Foodwise: Shaoguan
programme.desc: Tianran and Hannah are in the picturesque city of Shaoguan in Guangdong Province, South China. They try tea grown on Danxia landforms and feast on mountain produce, before getting hands-on with making rice noodles in a Hakka walled village. They learn about the Hakka people’s southward migration and the effect it had on local tea and food, and end their journey in a thousand-year-old Buddhist temple, seeing how the monks integrate their practice into everyday life, and discovering just why tea is so important to Zen.

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: Taiji Quan
programme.desc: Kleber travels to Chenjiagou in central China, the birthplace of Chen-style Taiji Quan. Also known as tai chi, the martial art is iconic for its slow movements and purported health benefits, but Kleber quickly discovers it’s the real deal: From being thrown around by teenagers to learning about the martial art’s Yin-Yang philosophy, Kleber experiences for himself how this kungfu style allows small to defeat big, and soft to beat strong.

programme.title: Thrill Seeker’s Guide to China: Mount Siguniang
programme.desc: In this episode, Host Tianran He is on a mission: To reach the summit of Mount Siguniang, a towering snowcapped mountain in southwestern China. Together with his friend Ma Chunlin, a photographer for National Geographic, they trek through one of China’s most beautiful and biodiverse hiking routes, before making for base camp. But with worsening weather conditions and severe altitude sickness, the odds are stacked against them. Ten years ago, Tianran failed his attempt at climbing Mount Siguniang’s First Peak – this time, he’s all in.

programme.title: Life as a Miao Silversmith
programme.desc: In this episode, Eva May steps into Maliao Village — a century-old silversmith village nestled in Leishan, Guizhou Province. Over the course of a week, she dives into the craft and daily lives of Miao men who carry on the silversmithing legacy. She works side by side with local silversmiths day in and day out, delving into the culture and techniques behind Miao silverware. programme.title: Tasting the Lifestyle of Chongqing
programme.desc: This episode uncovers Chongqing's lifestyle, where hot pot is more than food but a city symbol intertwined with climate and history. Tracing its roots at a hot pot museum and experiencing mountain restaurants, we see its evolution from dockworkers' fare to a trendy lifestyle. Exploring graffiti streets, old teahouses and Hongyadong, we find Chongqing balances vibrancy and leisure amid modern development.

programme.title: Bird's-eye China Ep.2

programme.title: Foodwise: Shantou
programme.desc: Tianran and Hannah are in Shantou, Guangdong Province in south China, where they drink more tea than anywhere else in the country. They'll savor the complex aroma of the curiously named "Duck Poo Fragrance" tea, as well as enjoy a more traditional "yum cha" breakfast. They get a taste of traditional handicrafts, from breaking bowls to make inlaid porcelain to rolling "kueh" rice cakes, and feast on everything from sweet and savory street snacks to the finest seafood dining.

programme.title: Foodwise: Shaoguan
programme.desc: Tianran and Hannah are in the picturesque city of Shaoguan in Guangdong Province, South China. They try tea grown on Danxia landforms and feast on mountain produce, before getting hands-on with making rice noodles in a Hakka walled village. They learn about the Hakka people’s southward migration and the effect it had on local tea and food, and end their journey in a thousand-year-old Buddhist temple, seeing how the monks integrate their practice into everyday life, and discovering just why tea is so important to Zen.

programme.title: Youthful China
programme.desc: The youth of a country is the future of that country. A series of documentaries focusing on the younger generation of China in which you get to see what they are achieving and what makes them tick!

programme.title: Observing Europe-Who owns Britain?
programme.desc: One of the first things that surprised CGTN's Li Jianhua after moving to Britain was discovering that London’s iconic black cabs are made by a subsidiary of China’s Geely. It’s not alone. Jaguar Land Rover belongs to India’s Tata, Mini is owned by Germany’s BMW, and many of Britain’s airports, utilities and landmark buildings have foreign owners. For decades, Britain embraced global investment. But the battle over British Steel suggests attitudes are changing. As concerns grow around national security and economic resilience, the question is no longer just who invests in Britain — but which industries are too strategic to be foreign-owned. In this latest episode of his series Observing...

programme.title: Observing Europe - Is migration "weaponized" in Europe?
programme.desc: Schengen - one of Europe’s greatest achievements - is being tested.The Schengen Area promised border-free travel across much of Europe. But migration, security concerns and increasingly polarized politics are putting that promise under pressure.From Ceuta to the return of internal border checks, CGTN Europe correspondent Li Jianhua looks at how Europe’s migration debate is reshaping Schengen — and asks: Can Europe keep its internal borders open as political pressure to control migration grows?

programme.title: BizTalk | AI-powered travel reshaping global tourism
programme.desc: China’s tourism market has continued to heat up this summer. Behind this boom, artificial intelligence (AI) is changing how people travel and is opening up new opportunities for the industry – from personalized itineraries to immersive experiences.In this episode of BizTalk, guests from the World Economic Forum, the World Travel & Tourism Council and Atout France explore how smart technologies can enhance visitor experiences, optimize destination management and unlock new growth opportunities. They also examine what China's emerging "AI tourism" focus could offer the global tourism industry.

programme.title: Meet China: When Chinese Dynamism Reshapes Landscapes — Boundless Challenges, Infinite Vitality
programme.desc: In this episode of Meet China, we journey from the cloud-piercing peaks of Zhangjiajie to the tech-driven streets of Shenzhen and the cassava farms of Vietnam. We meet extreme athletes redefining personal limits, turning vertical cliffs and open skies into new playgrounds. Then, we ride in a fully autonomous robotaxi through Shenzhen traffic, exploring the technology and regulations accelerating the global race for self-driving cars. Finally, we travel to Vietnam, where Chinese investment and expertise have transformed the cassava industry—boosting yields, stabilizing farmer incomes, and creating resilient supply chains reaching global markets. From skies to roads to fields, this episode...

programme.title: Follow the Money: Where Climate Capital Is Going
programme.desc: Clean energy investment has surpassed fossil fuel supply investment, signaling a fundamental shift in how markets address climate risk. Capital is accelerating into renewables, electrification, and industrial decarbonization—but how do we ensure these funds drive climate action? CGTN's Guan Xin moderates a panel at the 2026 Summer Davos Forum, bringing together voices from government, business, and international institutions to explore the trends, challenges, and prospects of climate capital allocation. Tune in to find out where climate capital is flowing and explore the opportunities in the green transition.#SummerDavos2026

programme.title: Observing Europe-Who owns Britain?
programme.desc: One of the first things that surprised CGTN's Li Jianhua after moving to Britain was discovering that London’s iconic black cabs are made by a subsidiary of China’s Geely. It’s not alone. Jaguar Land Rover belongs to India’s Tata, Mini is owned by Germany’s BMW, and many of Britain’s airports, utilities and landmark buildings have foreign owners. For decades, Britain embraced global investment. But the battle over British Steel suggests attitudes are changing. As concerns grow around national security and economic resilience, the question is no longer just who invests in Britain — but which industries are too strategic to be foreign-owned. In this latest episode of his series Observing...

programme.title: Observing Europe - Is migration "weaponized" in Europe?
programme.desc: Schengen - one of Europe’s greatest achievements - is being tested.The Schengen Area promised border-free travel across much of Europe. But migration, security concerns and increasingly polarized politics are putting that promise under pressure.From Ceuta to the return of internal border checks, CGTN Europe correspondent Li Jianhua looks at how Europe’s migration debate is reshaping Schengen — and asks: Can Europe keep its internal borders open as political pressure to control migration grows?

As concerns grow around national security and economic resilience, the question is no longer just who invests in Britain — but which industries are too strategic to be foreign-owned. In this latest episode of his series Observing...

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Shot In the While Sleeping (Richard Alessandri Case): On the night of July 16, 2000, the life of Edwige Alessandri changed forever. This mother, married to a supermarket boss, made a frantic emergency call in the town of Carpentras. She recounted that shortly after midnight, some men burst into her room and shot her husband while he slept. Who could have despised Richard Alessandri enough to kill him in cold blood in his own bed? Was he the victim of a robbery gone wrong, as claimed by his wife?

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: A Dire Deception (LAURENCE MAILLE CASE): On November 28, 2007, Laurence Maille disappeared. It was her partner, John Zablevski, who alerted the Vimy police in Pas-de-Calais. He explained that the young woman had left in the morning for a walk with their dog and never returned. An unprecedented search was immediately launched to try to find her. Beautiful, intelligent and generous, Laurence Maille had everything to be happy about and for 18 months, had found the perfect love in her partner.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: The Mystery of Room 602 (Véronique Pirotton Case): On October 31, 2013, Belgian politician Bernard Ouessfal rushed down the six flights of a hotel in Ostend where he had met up with his wife, Véronique, the day before. He had just found her unconscious on the bathroom floor with a mysterious plastic bag next to her. Despite the emergency rescue response, Véronique Pirotton died a few minutes later.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Two Accused of Murder (Jennifer Charron Case) - On Sunday, April 29, 2007, the body of Jennifer Charron, 21-years old, was found burnt to a crisp in a forest near Royan. The young waitress, who had been missing for two days, was visibly beaten and tied up. In this astonishing case, the clues examined by the experts will give them two leads: two men, two suspects with very different profiles... but investigators are convinced that they both have a direct link with the murder.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: THE CASE OF STÉPHANE KAMEUGNE - On December 24, 2008, the body of Stéphane Kameugne was fished out from a canal in Châlons-en-Champagne. The young man had been missing for two weeks and no one had seen him since the evening of his graduation ceremony from his engineering school. A theory soon emerged: the very drunk student had fallen over thea bridge over the canal which led to his death. But his parents and relatives did not believe this.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: The Savage Murder of a Mother and her Daughter (Amato Case)- On March 31, 2003, firefighters were called to a fire in a housing estate of Meyrargues, near Aix-en-Provence. On site, they discovered a horrific scene: the tortured and charred bodies of a mother and her daughter, Chantal and Audrey D'Amato, aged 53 and 24 respectively.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: A Night of Horror at Devil's Plateau (Marie-Jeanne Meyer Case) - On June 18, 2011, Marie-Jeanne Meyer, 17-years old, waved goodbye to her little sister before leaving for her daily jog on the heights of Tournon in Ardèche. She never came back. Three days later, her mutilated body was found in a freshly dug pit, near an area known to be cursed, "The Devil's Plateau." What's more, the crime scene looked like a mystical ritual ... Was it a ritual murder? Revenge? An unfortunate encounter? ...

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: A Mysterious Murder at the Farm (Valérie Bary Case)- On Friday, March 26, 2004, in the region of Dijon, Laurent Bary came home from his work to discover the lifeless body of his wife, Valerie, bathing in a pool of blood. According to the investigators' initial findings, the 38-year-old nurse's aid had been stabbed several times, seeming to validate the theory of a robbery gone wrong.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On July 13, 2011, two boaters retrieved a suitcase that was floating in the bay of Lorient. Inside, they discovered the tied up corpse of a man.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Bloody Christmas next to the Leman lake (CASE OF RUTH LÉGERET) - On January 4, 2006, Ruth Légeret was found dead in the middle of a pool of blood at her luxurious property in Vevey, Switzerland. Next to her was the lifeless body of her friend, Marina Studer. Who could have killed these two simple and wealthy widows? Clue after clue, the Swiss police's investigation would revolve around an environment of family jealousy and financial greed.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: September 16 2005. The lifeless body of Audrey Jouannet, 24, is found hidden under the bed in her small apartment in Soisy-sur-Seine. It soon becomes apparent that the young woman has been tortured at length before being strangled. But surprisingly, though the highly meticulous murderer has taken care to leave no sign of his passage, the autopsy reveals traces of sperm on the victim. It will take all of the investigators' intuition to pierce the mystery of this heinous crime...

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Sylvain Dromard finds the body of his wife Laurence lying in a pool of blood in the kitchen. The crime was particularly violent and the theory of a burglary that went wrong is soon excluded. But investigators don't understand who could want the adorable hairdresser of Saint-Martin-d'Ablois dead. During the investigation, the work of profilers will enable them to draw a very precise portrait of the murderer...

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: After an ordinary dinner, Pierre and Gabrielle Labrell suffer severe abdominal pains.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Nelly Crémel, 39, leaves her home to go jogging... never to return. Eight days later, after a vast search campaign, her body is found. There's no doubt that it's murder. programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: GLORY Kickboxing’s Summer of GLORY concluded with a massive event from the Johan Cruijff Arena in Amsterdam. In the night’s headliner, heavyweight champion Rico Verhoeven took on Brazilian challenger Guto Inocente. Verhoeven had defended his belt seven straight times since capturing the title in 2014. His winning streak inside the GLORY ring stood at 16. Inocente looked to dethrone the world’s top-ranked heavyweight riding the momentum of wins over Benjamin Adegbuyi, D’Angelo Marshall and Hesdy Gerges. Gold was also on the line in the co-main event, as longtime featherweight titleholder Robin van Roosmalen rematched interim champion Petchpanomrung Kiatmookao. The pair met previously at GLORY 41 — also in van Roosmalen’s home country of Holland — with the Dutchman taking home a controversial, majority-decision victory.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: GLORY is bringing out the heavy hitters for their final show of 2018, as an eight-man heavyweight tournament has been set for Rotterdam. Headlined by former heavyweight contender tournament winner Benjamin Adegbuyi and Jamal Ben Saddik as the top two seed, the winner will go on to win $100,000 for making it through the eight-man, three-round affair.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Today three newcomers to the competition create their fish dishes in a bid to be crowned Scottish champion. The standard is so high the veteran judge is moved to tears.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: This week three of Scotlands finest chefs are competing to be crowned champion. All week Ally McGrath has been keeping the veteran judge entertained with his very individual approach.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Today one chef will go home and today the veteran judge finds himself with a very difficult decision to make. Inventive Chef Michael Bremner is recreating the Scottish deserts of his childhood inspired by a local hero honoured by the Queen.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Today is the head to head. Scotlands two highest scoring chefs are cooking for judges Oliver Peyton, Prue Leith and Matthew Fort, for the very first time.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Today it is the starter course of the South West Regional heat. Chef Josh Eggleton is back for a third time. Josh is the Michelin star chef proprietor at The Pony and Trap near Bristol.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: There are some exciting dishes on the menu today as the three chefs from the South West a region renowned for its seafood - tackle the fish course.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It is the main course and Chef Chris Wheeler is out to show just how theatrical he can be, his ideas are surprising everyone in the kitchen. No one knows quite what to expect and the veteran chef is hoping it tastes as good as it looks.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Today is the dessert course and it is Josh Eggleton who has come up with the most ambitious dessert. He is creating his own self-serve ice cream made from vegetables, he is making everything from scratch.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.sub-title: S11 : E10 South West Ireland Judging
programme.desc: Today is the head to head. The South West regions two highest scoring chefs are cooking for judges Oliver Peyton, Prue Leith and Matthew Fort and today they are joined by guest judge, journalist and restaurant critic, Grace Dent.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: This week two newcomers to the competition are challenging reigning North West champion Matt Worswick. Adam Reid is Head Chef for one of the UKs leading culinary talents Simon Rogan, heading up Simons The French restaurant at Manchesters Midland hotel.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It is the fish course and reigning NW champion Matt Worswick has reason to be confident. Last year his fish course was shortlisted for the banquet in the national finals.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It is the main course of the North West Regional heat and the scores mean this is a crucial round. Matt Worswick may be the reigning champion but he is not yet assured of a place cooking for the judges and he is feeling the strain.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Its the dessert course and the three North West competitors are getting highly creative producing some of the most original and stunning desserts.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Today the two chefs are cooking for judges Matthew Fort, Prue Leith and Oliver Peyton. Its the dessert course that seals the fate of the chefs and the North West Champion is revealed.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Today three of the finest chefs from Wales are competing to be crowned champion. Two chefs are back for a second time: Phil Carmichael and Adam Bannister. Adam was crowed Welsh champion last year so this year Phil is back with something to prove.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Today is the fish course and newcomer Andrew Birch is confident, he is passionate about seafood. Adam Bannister has created a modern take on the old boil in the bag fish dinners and Phil has chosen to revamp the classic prawn cocktail.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: This week three of finest chefs from Wales are competing to be crowned champion. Returning Chef, Phil Carmichael is serving up his version of an O.B.E, a refined take on onions, bacon and egg.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: This week in the Welsh heat newcomer Andrew Birch is challenging two returning chefs, Adam Bannister and Phil Carmichael. It is the dessert course and one chef will go home.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Today is the head to head. The two highest scoring chefs from Wales are cooking for judges Oliver Peyton, Prue Leith and Matthew Fort who are joined by guest judge, blogger and food writer Rosie Birkett.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Three newcomers are competing to become regional Central champion - Daniel Smith, Andrew Scott and Danny Gill. Danny Gill is a former head chef at Daniel Cliffords two star restaurant Midsummer House.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It is the fish course and the chefs are using some of the UKs best seafood: lobster, salmon and Cornish crab. Daniel Smith may be classically trained but hes decided to take a risk adding a cheese custard to his lobster dish.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Two chefs are cooking venison. Danny Gill is making a venison wellington, inspired by his Dad, a former RAF chef who has served up Wellington for royalty. While Andrew Scott has sourced his venison from the Queens Scottish estate, Balmoral.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: This week three chefs from the central region are fighting to be crowned champion. Today one competitor will go home, only the two highest scoring chefs will make it through to the judging chamber. And the chefs are pushing themselves.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Today is the head to head. The Central regions two highest scoring chefs are cooking for judges Oliver Peyton, Prue Leith and Matthew Fort, for the very first time.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.sub-title: S11 : E26 London and South East Starter
programme.desc: Today three of the most exciting talents from London and the South East region are competing for a place in the National Finals.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.sub-title: S11 : E27 London and South East Fish
programme.desc: It is the fish course and chef Russell Bateman is celebrating the diversity of his beloved home town of London by combining lobster with jerk spices for an ambitious fish course with seven key elements.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.sub-title: S11 : E28 London and South East Main
programme.desc: Its the all important main course and returning contender Mark Froydenlund is banking on it being his strongest dish. Hes showcasing British Rose veal and celebrating the determination of British producers to bounce back from disaster.

programme.title: Great British Menu

programme.desc: Its the dessert course and the final chance for three of London and South Easts most competitive and talented chefs to get through to the judging chamber, today the veteran judge will send one chef home.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Mini Patel is back for a second attempt at the North East Regional title but hes competing against two young newcomers Tommy Banks and Chris Archer.

programme.title: Great British Menu

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Its the main course of the North East Region and overnight there has been a dramatic development. Its a tough and emotional day for the chefs.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It is a highly emotional day for one of the chefs as he prepares a dish which is inspired by and a tribute to his own Great Briton, his late Grandfather.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Today the two chefs are cooking for the judges Matthew Fort, Prue Leith and Oliver Peyton. Joining them is guest judge is John Williams MBE, the executive Head Chef at The Ritz, the only hotel to hold a royal warrant for banqueting.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: This week three top chefs from Northern Ireland are competing for a place in the National Finals. There are some varied and exciting starters, as the chefs get creative. And theres real shock and emotion as the veteran chef delivers his scores.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Today the atmosphere in the kitchen gets even more competitive as the three chefs from Northern Ireland dish cook their fish courses.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It is the main course and returning Chef Chris McGowan is feeling confident but part of his dish involves making his own venison sausages to serve with a venison rack, and getting it all done in time is straining his emotions.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The three chefs from Northern Ireland are cooking their desserts and one chef is on course for an historic score, he could beat his boss a veteran of GBM and achieve more marks than anyone has done throughout the history of the competition.

programme.title: Great British Menu

programme.title: CombiNation Plates
programme.desc: Join Bianca Osbourne to taste and combine! Fun CombiNATION Plates host Bianca Osbourne starts this episode with an inspired tribute to Georgian cuisine; Beef Tartare with Tkemali (sour plum sauce), marigold powder, and tart, crunchy pickles. Next; feast your eyes on her unique Hong Kong dumpling: plump scallops, pork, and veggies are blended, rolled, steamed, sliced, and then served with Crispy Yu Choy and XO. The common ingredient is rabbit! Georgia offers up Rabbit 'Mtsvadi', grilled and glazed with pomegranate reduction. Hong Kong represents with Sweet and Sour Rabbit, Grilled Pineapple and Red Pepper Coulis. Finally, Georgian Milk Braised meets Chinese/Hong Kong-style Roast Duck with quail egg and cheese stuffed 'Khachapuri Dumpling' and crunchy 'Peking Duck Crumble', and it's a plate no-one has ever seen before!

programme.desc: A witch in training (Katrina Browne) frames Hercules as an evil warlock and casts a love spell on Iolaus (Michael Hurst).

programme.title: Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.sub-title: S06 : E08 Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.desc: Zeus (Charles Keating) uses Ares' son, Evander (Joseph Main), to free Hera (Meg Foster) from the Abyss of Tartarus. With Kevin Sorbo, Michael Hurst and Kevin Smith.

programme.title: Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.desc: When his stepmother, Hera, destroys his family, Hercules is so consumed by hatred that he loses sight of his purpose to help people in need.

programme.title: Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.sub-title: S01 : E02 Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.desc: Hercules learns the real reason why a giant Cyclops has been terrorizing a village.

programme.title: Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.sub-title: S01 : E03 Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.desc: Hercules accompanies a town's citizens, cursed by Hera because of a theft at her temple, on a perilous journey to a city offering safe haven.

programme.title: Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.sub-title: S01 : E04 Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.desc: Hercules uncovers an elaborate plot calling for the murder of a king during a celebration honoring the god of wine.

programme.title: Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.sub-title: S01 : E05 Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.desc: Hercules confronts his half brother Ares, the god of war, in his attempt to prevent a teen-age boy from becoming one of the evil deity's soldiers.

programme.title: Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.sub-title: S01 : E06 Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.desc: Hercules attends a friend's wedding where Nemis the Centaur arrives and kidnaps the bride and her maid of honor.

programme.title: Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.sub-title: S01 : E07 Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.desc: Hercules' friend Iolaus fights for his life when Hera decides to punish him for an act of pride.

programme.title: Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.sub-title: S01 : E08 Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.desc: Hercules comes to the aid of a young couple taken hostage by a slave trader. Lucy Liu guest stars.

programme.title: Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.sub-title: S01 : E09 Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.desc: A power-hungry princess, Xena (Lucy Lawless), bent on killing Hercules uses his friend Lolaus to trap him.

programme.title: Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.sub-title: S01 : E10 Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.desc: Hercules and Lolaus challenge a wealthy couple's practice of forcing slaves to battle wild animals as a form of sadistic entertainment.

programme.title: Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.sub-title: S01 : E11 Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.desc: Hercules intervenes in a battle between the late King Memnos' children, Poena and Daulin.

programme.title: Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.sub-title: S01 : E12 Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.desc: Hercules' enemy, Xena (Lucy Lawless), wreaks havoc across the land until her troops force her to succumb to the gauntlet -- a deadly warrior ritual.

programme.title: Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.sub-title: S01 : E13 Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.desc: While working together to stop the marauding Darphus, Hercules and the warrior princess Xena (Lucy Lawless) take their personal relationship to a new level.

programme.title: Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.sub-title: S02 : E02 Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.desc: Hercules (Kevin Sorbo) helps his friend King Midas (Noel Trevarthen) whose gambling palace has gotten out of control with sadistic entertainment.

programme.title: Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.sub-title: S02 : E03 Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.desc: Hercules (Kevin Sorbo) confronts his mortal half-brother Iphicles (Kevin Smith), who has stolen his identity in order to ally himself with a warlord (Kenneth McGregor) and woo the leader's stepdaughter (Simone Kessell).

programme.title: Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.sub-title: S02 : E04 Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.desc: Hercules and Iolaus (Kevin Sorbo, Michael Hurst) incur the wrath of a horde of barbarians when they capture the group's leader (Brian Thompson).

programme.title: Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.sub-title: S02 : E05 Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.desc: Hercules (Kevin Sorbo) helps a centaur (Peter Muller) and his family combat the prejudice of a fanatical group of townspeople seeking ethnic purity.

programme.title: Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.sub-title: S02 : E06 Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.desc: Hercules (Kevin Sorbo) battles a whole town run by bandits in order to help a farmer (Bruce Phillips) reunite with his estranged wife (Maria Rangel).

programme.title: Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.sub-title: S02 : E07 Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.desc: Hercules' mother innocently enters into a romance with a man involved in a plot to kill her son. With Kevin Sorbo, Liddy Holloway and Martin Kove.

programme.title: Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.sub-title: S02 : E09 Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.desc: Hercules (Kevin Sorbo) comes to the rescue when his hustler friend Salmoneus (Robert Trebor) unknowingly sells antiquities belonging to the evil goddess Hera.

programme.title: Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.sub-title: S02 : E10 Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.desc: Maceus (Stig Eldred) plans to avenge his brother's death by luring Hercules into battle with the monster Echidna (Bridget Hoffman). With Glenn Shadix.

programme.title: Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.sub-title: S02 : E11 Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.desc: Hades (Erik Thomson) summons Hercules to save the spirit of a young man (Craig Hall) who has been tricked into trading places with King Sisyphus (Ray Henwood).

programme.title: Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.sub-title: S02 : E12 Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.desc: When their friend is framed for murder, Hercules and Iolaus search for a mystical relic which allows nothing but the truth to be uttered in its presence.

programme.title: Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.sub-title: S02 : E13 Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.desc: Hercules' good time at a harvest festival is interrupted by the arrival of an assassin (Karen Sheperd) sent by his vindictive stepmother. With Michael Hurst.

programme.title: Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.sub-title: S02 : E14 Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.desc: Hercules and Iolaus venture inside an active volcano in order to help the legendary Jason (Jeffrey Thomas) and the Argonauts track down thieving warriors.

programme.title: Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.sub-title: S02 : E15 Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.desc: Hercules falls in love while helping a woman (Audie England) and her band of rebels defeat a tyrannical king (Michael Keir-Morrisey). Michael Hurst co-stars.

programme.title: Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.sub-title: S02 : E16 Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.desc: Hercules promotes peace by organizing an athletic competition between the warring Spartans and Eleans, thus creating the Olympic Games. With Robert Trebor.

programme.title: Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.sub-title: S02 : E17 Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.desc: Iolaus is used as a pawn by the scheming love goddess Aphrodite to prevent a marriage between the children (Jonathan Blick, Claire Yarlett) of two feuding kings (Ian Mune, Stephen Tozer).

programme.title: Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.sub-title: S02 : E18 Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.desc: Hercules and Iolaus get caught in the middle of a love triangle when they volunteer to help a king (Joel Tobeck) rescue his kidnapped fiancee (Josephine Davison).

programme.title: Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.sub-title: S02 : E19 Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.desc: Iolaus discovers he has a royal look-alike, Orestes, and ends up helping him defend his throne from a jealous brother and a conniving general (Will Kempe).

programme.title: Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.sub-title: S02 : E20 Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.desc: A friend (Paul Gittins) of Hercules and Iolaus is accused of theft when an angry god (Jane Cresswell) distorts reality by making people appear to have performed acts they didn't.

programme.title: Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.sub-title: S02 : E21 Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.desc: The wedding of Hercules' mother (Liddy Holloway) to the legendary Greek hero Jason (Jeffrey Thomas) is threatened by another of Hera's plots to kill Hercules. With Michael Hurst.

programme.title: Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.sub-title: S02 : E22 Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.desc: Hercules intervenes when a young man with divine powers is manipulated by a relative (Grant Bridger) into using his gift for villainous purposes. With Robert Trebor as Salmoneus.

programme.title: Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.sub-title: S02 : E23 Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.desc: A dying centaur (Tony Blackett) asks Hercules for help when a centaur group's struggle for equal rights with humans takes a violent turn. With Robert Trebor.

programme.title: Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.sub-title: S02 : E24 Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.desc: An eager young writer (Owen Black) learns a lesson about courage when he helps Hercules and Iolaus rescue a maiden trapped in a cave.

programme.title: Hercules: The Legendary Journeys

programme.desc: A storm at sea maroons Hercules (Kevin Sorbo) on an island where he deals with pirates, sand monsters and a wanted killer (Jeremy Roberts) he is transporting to Sparta.

programme.title: Hercules: The Legendary Journeys

programme.desc: Hercules (Kevin Sorbo) intervenes when he discovers that his friend, the inventor Daedalus (Derek Payne), is creating weapons of mass destruction for an evil king (Frankie Stevens).

programme.title: Hercules: The Legendary Journeys

programme.title: Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.sub-title: S03 : E06 Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.desc: Hercules (Kevin Sorbo) helps the monster Echidna (Bridget Hoffman) and the giant Typhon (Glenn Shadix) find their kidnapped child. With Michael Hurst.

programme.title: Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.sub-title: S03 : E07 Hercules: The Legendary Journeys

programme.title: Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.sub-title: S03 : E08 Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.desc: Queen Parnassa (Jane Thomas) strikes Hercules (Kevin Sorbo) with amnesia so he will believe she is his mother and agree to lead her army.

programme.title: Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.sub-title: S03 : E09 Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.desc: Iolaus (Michael Hurst) has a dream which leads Hercules (Kevin Sorbo) and him on a mission to save male babies from two rulers (Edward Newborn, Denise O'Connell) who fear a prophecy.

programme.title: Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.sub-title: S03 : E10 Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.desc: A young dragon starts killing warriors and destroying villages at the same time a warlord (Rene Naufahu) returns from exile seeking revenge on his enemies. Stars Kevin Sorbo and Michael Hurst.

programme.title: Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.sub-title: S03 : E11 Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.desc: Iolaus joins his look-alike cousin, King Orestes, on a dangerous diplomatic mission to ask a power-hungry ruler to support a new league of kingdoms.

programme.title: Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.sub-title: S03 : E12 Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.desc: Xena's old enemy Callisto returns from the afterlife when she makes a deal with Hera to kill Hercules in exchange for immortality. With Michael Hurst.

programme.title: Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.sub-title: S03 : E13 Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.desc: Saving a beautiful creature that is part woman and part deer pits Hercules against his half brother Ares (Kevin Smith) and the vengeful Prince Nestor (Steve Hall). With Michael Hurst.

programme.title: Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.sub-title: S03 : E14 Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.desc: When Hercules proposes to Serena (Sam Jenkins), he must deal with Iolaus' disapproval, Deianeira's (Tawny Kitaen) hurt feelings and Ares' (Kevin Smith) plot to destroy the relationship.

programme.title: Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.sub-title: S03 : E15 Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.desc: Xena (Lucy Lawless) intervenes when Ares and Strife (Kevin Smith, Joel Tobeck) frame Hercules for the murder of someone close to him. With Michael Hurst and Renee O'Connor.

programme.title: Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.sub-title: S03 : E16 Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.desc: Iolaus' search for his missing cousin Regina (Amber Sainsbury) takes him to a commune where everyone has been brainwashed by a seemingly benevolent leader (Matthew Chamberlain).

programme.title: Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.sub-title: S03 : E18 Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.desc: Hera plays up to Augeus' (Grant Bridger) delusion that he is Zeus by giving him a taste of godly power, which he can keep if he kills Hercules.

programme.title: Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.sub-title: S03 : E19 Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.desc: Autolycus (Bruce Campbell) steals a powerful stone that causes Hercules to travel back in time, where he meets up with his beloved Serena and the ruthless Ares (Kara Zediker, Kevin Smith).

programme.title: Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.sub-title: S03 : E20 Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.desc: Hercules and Iolaus rescue a kidnapped princess only to discover that her capture was part of a larger conspiracy to overthrow the rulers of two kingdoms.

programme.title: Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.sub-title: S03 : E21 Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.desc: When a murder suspect (Lindsey Ginter) escapes and flees into an old mine, only Hercules and Iolaus can keep a vengeful mob away until the crime is solved.

programme.title: Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.sub-title: S03 : E22 Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.desc: Shipwrecked on Atlantis, Hercules offers to help a psychic (Claudia Black) convince her fellow citizens that the destruction of their island is imminent.

programme.title: Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.sub-title: S04 : E01 Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.desc: Hercules and Autolycus (Kevin Sorbo, Bruce Campbell) team up to rescue the caretaker (Kerry Gallagher) of golden Harpy eggs from the clutches of a giant (Glenn Shadix) living in the clouds.

programme.title: Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.sub-title: S04 : E02 Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.desc: After his memory is purged by Fortune, the goddess of luck (Lori Dungey), Iolaus (Michael Hurst) becomes a common thief and faces off against his forgotten ally, Hercules (Kevin Sorbo).

programme.title: Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.sub-title: S04 : E03 Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.desc: Hercules reminisces about the accidental death of a childhood bully, when Celesta (Belinda Waymouth) arrives to take the brother of the deceased boy to the Elysian Fields.

programme.title: Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.sub-title: S04 : E04 Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.desc: Hercules (Kevin Sorbo) and Iolaus (Michael Hurst) join forces with the beautiful pirate Nebula (Gina Torres) to battle the deadly spider-woman Arachne (Josephine Davison).

programme.title: Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.sub-title: S04 : E05 Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.desc: Following a fierce battle with Ares (Kevin Smith), Hercules (Kevin Sorbo) races to rescue Iolaus (Michael Hurst) from a cutthroat parallel universe and save the life of his father, Zeus. With Lucy Lawless and Renee O'Connor.

programme.title: Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.sub-title: S04 : E06 Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.desc: After finding out he's a father, Hercules (Kevin Sorbo) engages in a fierce battle with Ares (Kevin Smith) over the life of the magically endowed baby. With Michael Hurst.

programme.title: Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.sub-title: S04 : E07 Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.desc: Hercules (Kevin Sorbo) fights members of a renegade Amazon clan to reunite a blind teen-ager with his sister, who is a member of the female warriors' group.

programme.title: Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.sub-title: S04 : E09 Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.desc: A blacksmith's forged likeness of Hercules (Kevin Sorbo) comes to life and, with the goddess Discord's encouragement, wreaks havoc on a local town. With Cory Everson and Meighan Desmond.

programme.title: Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.sub-title: S04 : E10 Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.desc: Hercules (Kevin Sorbo) is tried for manslaughter when a man (Barry Duffield) impersonating him is killed while doing a good deed.

programme.title: Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.sub-title: S04 : E11 Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.desc: Hercules and Iolaus reminisce about their first battle with the fire-breathing Ghidra, the seductive powers of Medea (Jacinda Barrett) and Hera's meddling tactics. With Ian Bohen.

programme.title: Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.sub-title: S04 : E12 Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.desc: Salmoneus and Autolycus (Robert Trebor, Bruce Campbell) pass themselves off as members of an all-female dance troupe led by the widow Twanky after being accused of murdering King Pholus.

programme.title: Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.sub-title: S04 : E13 Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.desc: Callisto (Hudson Leick) joins forces with Gabrielle's evil daughter, Hope (Amy Morrison), in an effort to go back in time and prevent the birth of Hercules by killing his mother.

programme.title: Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.sub-title: S04 : E14 Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.desc: Hercules tries to escape the Netherworld in time to help Iolaus prevent Callisto (Hudson Leick) from murdering his mother (Kim Michalis) and his unborn self.

programme.title: Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.sub-title: S04 : E15 Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.desc: The writers and producers of ``Hercules'' panic when the star of the show is nowhere to be found following an earthquake in modern day Los Angeles.

programme.title: Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.sub-title: S04 : E16 Hercules: The Legendary Journeys
programme.desc: Iolaus and Autolycus (Michael Hurst, Bruce Campbell) race to save Hercules after he is put on a butcher's chopping block following his transformation into a pig by Discord (Meighan Desmond).

programme.title: Deep Water Salvage
programme.desc: When bundles of cedarwood tree trunks are smashed apart, releasing thousands of logs on the shoreline, Jeremy and his crew must move fast to recover the cargo.

programme.title: Digging For Britain
programme.desc: Alice Roberts and Matt Williams present more outstanding archaeology. In the east of Britain, sites include Must Farm, Colchester, Oakington, Lyminge and Silchester.

programme.title: Digging For Britain
programme.desc: Alice Roberts and Matt Williams visit the Dorset Country Museum, where they explore finds from archaeological digs across the west of Britain.

programme.title: Walking Through History
programme.desc: Tony takes in the wonderful seascapes of the North Norfolk coast, determined to uncover how it remained so unchanged through the Victorian age of industry.

programme.title: Walking Through History
programme.sub-title: S02 : E05 The Dark Age Of Northumbria
programme.desc: Tony sets out on the trail of St Cuthbert across the ancient kingdom of Northumbria stretching across its 7th-century extent from Edinburgh to York.

programme.title: Ross Kemp: Shipwreck Treasure Hunter
programme.desc: Ross prepares to explore the wreck of a sunken steam-age ship, the Iona II. The ship went down with a mystery cargo on board. Determined to solve the mystery, Ross meets with a maritime historian who has uncovered the Iona II’s shocking purpose.

programme.title: Ancient Superstructures
programme.sub-title: S03 : E01 The Holy Sepulchre of Jerusalem
programme.desc: This episode reveals the secrets of the Holy Sepulchre, the most sacred Christian site in the world. Built on the site of the death and resurrection of Jesus of Nazareth, it has a unique atmosphere.Today, thanks to the use of new technologies, the Holy Sepulchre reveals its secrets as never before.

programme.title: Ancient Superstructures
programme.sub-title: S03 : E02 Notre Dame of Paris
programme.desc: In this episode, we discover Notre-Dame de Paris, one of the most popular cathedrals in the world. A superstructure in stone, wood and glass, Notre Dame is notable for its finesse and grandeur. The greatest devastation it ever suffered was the fire in 2019. We’ll see how, after surviving a fire, the cathedral has been rebuilt.

programme.title: Ancient Superstructures
programme.desc: This episode sheds light on Tikal, one of the largest archaeological sites and urban centers of pre-Columbian Mayan civilization. Tikal was the capital of the most powerful kingdom built by the Maya.

programme.title: Ancient Superstructures
programme.desc: This episode tells the story of the incredible site of Chichen Itza, in Mexico. Considered as one of the New Seven Wonders of the World, the Mayan city of Chichen Itza was the capital of a powerful civilization: the Itzas

programme.title: Ancient Superstructures
programme.desc: The Sphinx is the most monumental ancient sculpture in the world. Half-man, half-lion, this monument arouses the curiosity of the whole world.

programme.title: Ancient Superstructures
programme.desc: This episode takes us to the heart of Chambord, the largest and most iconic French castle. Designed on the medieval model of fortified castles with its enclosure and large corner towers, this jewel is inspired by the Gothic style.
